name: JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort
positioning: Golf and family resort on a 300-acre setting in Aventura, north of Miami, with two 18-hole championship golf courses, the Tidal Cove Waterpark and a three-story Spa & Wellness Center (officially JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort & Spa)
best_for: Families who want a waterpark with water slides and a kids pool on site
Golfers who want two championship courses at the resort

facts.text: The resort is in Aventura, Florida, a city that began with a country club 12 miles north of Miami.
The resort spreads across a 300-acre setting with Mediterranean-inspired architecture, marble walkways and fountains.
The grounds include lush tropical gardens and a 100-year-old banyan tree.
Turnberry was at the core of Don Soffer's vision for present-day Aventura, a city planned out on a cocktail napkin.
The interior design takes inspiration from Miami's art-deco history, with clean, geometric lines.
Every guest room and suite has a private furnished balcony or terrace, with views of foliage, the ocean, the golf courses or the pools.
Rooms have marble bathrooms and floor-to-ceiling windows.
The resort has two 18-hole championship golf courses, the Soffer and the Miller, designed by Robert Trent Jones, Sr. and reimagined by World Golf Hall of Famer Raymond Floyd.
The Soffer and Miller courses have hosted numerous Florida PGA and LPGA championships.
On the Miller Course, pink flamingos nest on Lake Julius, named for US Open champion Julius Boros.
Bourbon Steak by Michael Mina is a steakhouse with a wood-burning grill serving steak and fresh seafood.
Aventura Mall is a seven-minute walk from the resort.

highlights.text: Tidal Cove Waterpark has a 60-foot tower with seven water slides, a kids pool with an aquatic play structure and 25 private cabanas.
Tidal Cove Waterpark is complimentary for two guests per room daily.
Tidal Cove has the nation's first FlowRider Triple.
The three-story Spa & Wellness Center offers Babor treatments and Himalayan salt rooms.
The adults-only Cascata Pool sits behind the main lobby.

considerations.text: The resort is not on a beach.
The pools and waterpark are also open to day-pass guests, so poolside loungers can be in demand.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the luxury resort experience.
